To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a holistic SARS-CoV-2 testing platform that allows large scale testing in a rapid and efficient manner, even during the current shortage of sample collection devices and reagents.
a large-scale SARS CoV2 test was established in 10 weeks and that it is possible to identify SARS CoV-2 positive individuals in the population.

the SARS CoV-2 virus is a highly contagious virus that can be transmitted by aerosols, that the SARS-CoV-2 virus causes a severe disease in a significant proportion of infected individuals, that the Sars-CoV-2 pandemic can be stopped by large scale testing and by contact tracing, and that large scale testing can be set in place in a fast and flexible manner.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of rapid, large scale SARS CoV-2 testing in the context of a pandemic.

the development of a holistic testing platform for SARS CoV-2 that is based on a novel type of sample collection swab and a novel in house developed RNA isolation system, and that is independent of current bottlenecks.
the establishment of a holistic, large scale, rapid and cost effective testing platform for SARS CoV-2.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented strategy of testing for COVID 19 is a valid and efficient approach to prevent and contain the spread of the virus in a population.
our testing strategy was a success in the sense that the local SARS CoV2 pandemic could be contained, and a 'New Normal', i.e. a functioning local infrastructure, was reestablished.

we have successfully set up a holistic SARS-CoV-2 testing platform that can be applied to a variety of different scenarios, e.g. to support the local economy by allowing a resumption of work in critical infrastructure, to identify potential SARS-CoV2 carriers in the community, and to monitor the infection status of a population.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our testing platform was able to detect SARS CoV2 infections in a low frequency pandemic area in a timely manner.
our test was able to detect SARS CoV2 in a low frequency pandemic area in Germany, that the test was able to be implemented rapidly, and that it was able to be scaled up to a large number of tests.

we were able to establish a holistic testing platform that is able to provide large scale COVID 19 testing with high sensitivity and specificity in the absence of shortages of sample collection tools or molecular biological reagents and with the ability to communicate medical results electronically in a safe manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
large scale testing can be set-up quickly, safely, and efficiently, even in areas with low prevalence.

the establishment of large scale SARS CoV2 testing in the context of the present pandemic is possible and can be achieved by a combination of a flexible testing platform and the involvement of all relevant actors.
large scale SARS CoV-2 testing can be performed with high accuracy even in the absence of a global pandemic, and that the results can be used to identify and isolate the SARS CoV -2 positive cases.
